text: Model change, live Oct 26: each season now starts from the average of KenPom's and Barttorvik's preseason ratings (was KenPom alone). Backtest, spread plays 2.5+ vs the opener: November line value +1.09 to +1.29 (2015-17) and +0.83 to +0.87 (2024-26); totals unchanged.

Rule change, live Oct 26: for the first 7 days of each season, model totals are shifted so the day's average matches KenPom's scoring level. Before any games are played the model starts from last season's scoring, which put every 2026-27 total about 3.6 points below KenPom and the market. Two unders logged before the rule and not bet were voided (corrections below); two that were bet stand.

This channel posts every BET the model logs, at the time it is logged, whether or not it is bet, then its close, CLV and result. Posts are never edited; mistakes get a correction message. Bets logged before the channel opened are posted on its first day with their original logged time. The bet log is also timestamped with OpenTimestamps after every run (bets/bets.csv.ots in the repo).

Model frozen from Oct 26, 2026 until a Jan 15, 2027 checkpoint: no changes to the ratings, the projection, the betting rules or the cutoffs (spreads 2.5+, totals 3+, +2% EV at the price). Team ratings keep updating from every result, as the frozen code does. Any exception will be announced here the day it goes live. Frozen version: commit dfb4bc7 in the repo (MODEL_FREEZE.md lists file fingerprints).

Schedule note, recorded Oct 27: the card checks lines every 10 minutes around the clock. Overnight checks moved from every 30 minutes to every 10 minutes at midnight Oct 27, before the first games on Nov 1. No change to the ratings, the projection, the betting rules, the cutoffs or staking; plays may simply be alerted sooner after a line posts overnight. Recorded in MODEL_FREEZE.md.

Protocol note, recorded Oct 28: the season's final forward-test read moves from March 16 to Sunday, March 14 (Selection Sunday), after every game through that day is graded, so the verdict lands before the NCAA tournament starts. Same games (Nov 1 through Mar 14), same measures and thresholds; no game had been played. No change to the model, the betting rules or staking. Protocol v2.1, recorded in MODEL_FREEZE.md.

Record note, recorded Oct 28, before the first games: closing-line value (CLV) now has one definition everywhere, the forward test's primary close. For each sportsbook, its last fresh quote (no more than 5 minutes old) in the 15 minutes before tip; the close is the median across books. Result posts, the card, the record page, the weekly charts and the model-check alert all use it. A play with no fresh closing quote shows CLV as unavailable, with the reason, and is left out of averages; it is never counted as zero. Averages show how many decided plays have a close. The same-book CLV shown before is kept as a diagnostic only. No result had been posted yet, so nothing earlier changes. No change to the model, the plays, the betting rules or staking. CLV tracking is built, and will be marked verified only after it is checked on the first game. Recorded in MODEL_FREEZE.md.

Staking note, recorded Oct 28, before the first games: the stake cap (a market's stake held at half when its closing-line value averages below zero after 25 bets) now uses the same closing-line value the record shows, the median of each book's last fresh quote in the 15 minutes before tip. Bets without a fresh closing quote are left out and counted, so the cap waits for 25 bets that have one. The thresholds are unchanged and no current stake changes. No change to the model, the plays or the betting rules. Recorded in MODEL_FREEZE.md.

Logging note, recorded Oct 28, before the first games: when ESPN's start time and the odds feed's start time differ by 30 minutes or more, we now also log quotes in the 20 minutes before ESPN's start. The official closing-line value still uses the feed's start; a second closing-line value at ESPN's start is shown beside it, labeled as a diagnostic. This applies now to Memphis Over 152.5 at Iowa State (feed 6:00 pm ET, ESPN and the confirmed tip 7:00 pm ET). No change to the model, the plays, the stakes or grading. Recorded in MODEL_FREEZE.md.

Reporting note, recorded Oct 28, before the first games: closing-line value is now labeled "Alert CLV (points)". It measures the alert's number against the consensus close (the median of each book's last fresh quote in the 15 minutes before tip), not the price you got. Result posts now list each closing book's number and price beside it, and a close built from a single book is flagged as a one-book close. No change to the model, the plays, the stakes or grading. Recorded in MODEL_FREEZE.md.

New bet type, recorded Oct 29, before the first games: Band B. When the model's edge on a spread is 2 to 2.49 points (just under the 2.5-point cutoff) and the play still clears the +2% expected-value rule at the best price, it is posted as "BAND B (0.5u)" at half a unit, flat. Band B has its own record line and is never added to the main record, which stays exactly as it was: same model, same plays, same 1-unit stakes, same grading. Totals band B is switched off. The rule that decides whether band B stays (at 300 graded plays or March 14) is written in the forward-test protocol, Appendix B. Recorded in MODEL_FREEZE.md.
